alreadyLatest: You're already on the latest version
restartTimeout: Timed out waiting for the service to restart. Check the backend logs, or confirm artex was started with start.sh / start.bat.
confirmUpdate:
Update to {version}?

The update restarts the program, and running tasks will be interrupted.
confirmDockerNote: Note: updating inside the container only replaces the program itself and does not update toolchains in the image such as playwright / nmap. If the new version depends on new tools, use docker compose pull instead.
rollbackConfirm:
Roll back to the previous version?

The program will restart, and running tasks will be interrupted.
Note: the database schema will not be rolled back, so the old version may not be able to read data written by the new version.
rolledBack: Switched to the previous version, restarting…
restarting: Restarting to apply the new version, please wait (the page will refresh automatically)…
title: Version & updates
description: Check for and install new versions from GitHub. Updating restarts the program, and running tasks will be interrupted.
unreachable: Can't reach GitHub: {error}　Configure a global proxy above and try again.
noAsset: {latest} has no release package for {os}/{arch} (missing {asset}), so it can't be updated automatically.
willDownload: Will download <mono>{asset}</mono>{size}, verify its SHA256 and run a smoke test before replacing the current version; on failure the current version is kept automatically.
upToDate: You're already on the latest version.
dockerNote: Under Docker, updating only replaces the program itself and does not update toolchains in the image such as playwright / nmap. Also, <mono> docker compose up -d </mono> recreates the container and reverts to the image's bundled version. To upgrade the image as well, run <mono>docker compose pull artex && docker compose up -d artex</mono>.
startupNote: One-click updates rely on a guard script to restart the program. Start ARTEX via <mono>start.sh</mono> (on Windows, <mono>start.bat</mono>); when running the artex binary directly, it will not be relaunched automatically after exit.
